description: Find no-commitment monthly VPS plans that meet minimum specs, sorted by value index (default) or by price. Returns the best matching plan per provider unless one_per_provider is false.

max_usd_monthly.description: Maximum pre-tax monthly price in USD

one_per_provider.description: Only the best plan per provider (default true)

provider_country.description: Two-letter country code of the provider company, e.g. US, DE, KR, JP

seoul_region.description: Only providers with a Seoul (South Korea) region

sort.description: value = best value index first (default), price = cheapest first

name: find_vps
title: Find VPS plans
